about_the_game:
You've never truly been to the Great Wall. You've seen the stones, but not the story. Until now.

The Legend of The Great Wall is an immersive VR educational experience that vividly recreates the history, architecture, and legendary stories of the Great Wall through virtual reality technology. From the battlefields of the Western Zhou Dynasty to the peaks of the modern Great Wall, you'll witness firsthand the birth, struggles, and legends of this world wonder.

Through stunning 3D replicas, interactive exploration, and dynamic historical reenactments, the story of the Great Wall comes to life!

 

What You'll Experience:

·360° Time Travel: Stand on the bricks of the Great Wall, surveying the millennia-old dragon-shaped wonder, or dive into Western Zhou battlefields to repel invaders with bows and arrows.

・Realistic 3D Modeling: Explore every detail of the Great Wall's construction.

・Role-playing & Decision-making: Become a Western Zhou soldier facing the pivotal choice of whether to build the Great Wall - each decision reshapes history's course 26.

・Interactive Learning: Light beacon fires to learn ancient military communication systems, combining wisdom and bravery.

・History & Engineering: From Qin unification to Ming expansion, uncover the political and technological significance behind the Wall.

・Cultural Preservation Awareness: Compare ancient and modern perspectives to reflect on heritage conservation's global value.

・Language & Fun: Solve lantern riddles and collect fragments to effortlessly absorb knowledge.

・Guided Mode: Follow narration to learn historical contexts (perfect for classrooms).

・Free Explore Mode: Wander the Wall, enjoy aerial views, or participate in mini-games (ideal for self-directed learning).

 

Recommended For:

 

・Schools & Educational Institutions

Provides immersive teaching tools for history and cultural studies, sparking student interest.

 

・Parents & Homeschoolers

Enables interactive Chinese cultural learning, replacing rote memorization from textbooks.

 

・Museums & Cultural Centers

Serves as a standout attraction to engage visitors with high-tech cultural experiences.

 

・International Schools & Language Programs

Helps students intuitively understand Chinese culture while assisting Mandarin language learning.
